title: Al Jazeera investigation: Israeli soldiers in the West Bank are also settlers
detail: Al Jazeera published an investigation reporting that a number of Israeli soldiers serving in the West Bank are also settlers living there, blurring the line between military and settler violence. Findings are per Al Jazeera and not independently verified here.

title: Israeli forces kill 14-year-old child in occupied West Bank
detail: A headline reported Israeli forces killed a 14-year-old child in the occupied West Bank. Details such as location and circumstances were not available in the feed summary.
